post.description: Creates a routing for one (account_id, payment_method) pair.

start_split.description: Splits the entry of the route across several steps by percentage. Omit to start every payment on step 1. Entries must sum to 100; returned only when the route has a split entry.

provider_id.description: Required on provider steps (SMART_ROUTING on a smart routing step); absent on action steps. Must match the provider of the connection.

connection_id.description: Required on provider steps; absent on action and smart routing steps. Must be ACTIVE and support the payment_method.

action.description: Makes the step an action step that ends the route: CANCEL rejects the payment, CAPTURE captures the authorization after action_delay, HOLD_FOR_REVIEW leaves it pending manual review, REVERT reverts it after a post-payment fraud screening. CAPTURE and HOLD_FOR_REVIEW follow an APPROVED or SUCCEEDED_GROUP output of a payment or smart routing step, REVERT the outputs of a fraud step that runs after the payment, CANCEL never an approval. An action step has no provider_id, connection_id or output.

action_delay.description: Only with action = CAPTURE. ISO-8601 duration between the approval and the capture, at least PT1M and at most P7D. Omit to capture as soon as the approval is processed.

status.description: APPROVED, DECLINED, DECLINE_GROUP, MAC_CODE_GROUP, SUCCEEDED_GROUP, PENDING (fraud, 3DS and authentication steps only) or INTERNAL_ERROR.

decline_types.description: Decline sub-statuses. On DECLINE_GROUP, required unless group_id is sent; with group_id it must equal the group's members. Not allowed on SUCCEEDED_GROUP.

group_id.description: Id of a decline, Merchant Advice Code or succeeded group of the account (see List Decline Groups and List Succeeded Groups). Required on MAC_CODE_GROUP and SUCCEEDED_GROUP, optional on DECLINE_GROUP, not allowed otherwise. Must be of the kind the status expects.

retry.description: true attempts the same provider once more when this outcome happens, before following next. Only on DECLINED, INTERNAL_ERROR and DECLINE_GROUP. On update, an omitted retry keeps the stored value.

next_split.description: Splits the fallback across several steps by percentage: at least 2 entries whose percentages sum to 100. next is optional next to it and, when sent, must equal the first entry; responses return next = first entry alongside next_split.

output.description: Per-outcome handlers of a provider step. Not allowed on an action step.

network_token_on.description: Only on payment provider steps of a CARD routing. true pays with the network token of the card when one is available; requires the organization onboarded to network tokens and a provider that supports them (network_token_enable on the response), otherwise 400 NETWORK_TOKEN_NOT_ONBOARDED or NETWORK_TOKEN_NOT_SUPPORTED. Omitted on update keeps the stored value; false turns it off.

three_d_secure_exemptions.description: Only on 3DS provider steps. The SCA exemptions this step may apply. Omitted on update keeps the stored list; [] clears it.

fraud.description: Configuration of a fraud provider step. Only on FRAUD providers; omitted on update keeps the stored configuration.

report_only.description: Score without acting on the result. Only on a fraud step reached from declined outputs of a payment step.

smart_routing.description: Makes the step a smart routing step (provider_id SMART_ROUTING, no connection_id). Card routings only, one per route.

no_retry_decline_types.description: Decline sub-statuses after which the next provider of the set is not tried.

no_retry_failure_causes.description: Failure causes (for example PROVIDER_TIMEOUT) after which the next provider of the set is not tried.

items.description: A provider attempt (provider_id + connection_id) or an action step (action). index values are contiguous starting at 1.

condition_sets.description: Optional. Ordered by sort_number, first matching set wins.

condition_type.description: See Routing Conditions for the catalog: COUNTRY, CARD_ISSUER_COUNTRY, AMOUNT, CARD_TYPE, CARD_BRAND, CARD_BIN, TRANSACTION_TYPE, METADATA, ADDITIONAL_FIELD, TIME_PERIOD, VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT.

values.description: Empty only on an AMOUNT condition with currency, which then matches any amount in that currency.

key.description: METADATA: the metadata key. ADDITIONAL_FIELD: the supported field name.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Required on AMOUNT and on VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT with limit_by = VOLUME.

time_period_repeat_amount.description: TIME_PERIOD and VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT: every how many units of time_period_repeat_frequency (schedule), or the length of a DAILY window in days, 1 to 90 (limit).

time_period_repeat_frequency.description: TIME_PERIOD: recurrence unit. VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT: period of the limit, DAILY, MONTHLY or QUARTERLY.

time_period_repetition_days.description: TIME_PERIOD only. Days of the week the schedule applies to; needs a frequency.

time_period_start_time.description: TIME_PERIOD only. Start of the daily time window (HH:mm:ss), together with time_period_end_time.

time_period_end_time.description: TIME_PERIOD only. End of the daily time window (HH:mm:ss), inclusive.

timezone.description: UTC offset. TIME_PERIOD: offset the schedule is read in (defaults to the offset of values[0]). VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT: whole-hour offset where periods start (defaults to +00:00).

limit_by.description: VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT only. Count payments (default) or sum amounts in currency.

payments_count.description: VOLUME_PAYMENTS_LIMIT only. Which payments count toward the limit. Default ALL.

conditions.description: Conditions combined with logical AND. See Routing Conditions.

route.description: Same shape as default_route, including start_split, output[].next_split and action steps.
